title: WTc11 iPSC Culture and Maintenance
author: Connor Ludwig
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8rhhv36
materials: Carefully aspirate supernatant from pelleted conicals.

steps.title: Prepare Complete StemFlex Medium
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the StemFlex medium by combining the supplement and basal medium.

substeps.instruction: Thaw StemFlex Supplement 10X at room temperature for ~2 hours or overnight at 2°C to 8°C (do not thaw at 37°C).
Gently invert the thawed supplement 3-5 times to mix.
Aseptically transfer 50 mL of StemFlex Supplement 10X into a bottle of StemFlex Basal Medium (450 mL fill).
Gently invert the bottle several times to obtain 500 mL of homogenous complete medium.

steps.title: Store Complete StemFlex Medium
steps.instruction: Store the reconstituted medium or supplement aliquots according to the required duration.

substeps.instruction: Store complete StemFlex Medium at 2°C to 8°C for up to 2 weeks, or aliquot and store at -5°C to -20°C for up to 6 months.
Alternatively, create usage-size aliquots of the supplement and freeze at -5°C to -20°C for up to 6 months, avoiding multiple freeze-thaw cycles.

steps.title: Coat Plates with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Prepare and apply Matrigel coating to the desired wells or plates.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Matrigel on ice and dilute in pre-chilled Knockout DMEM to a final volume of 100 μg/mL.
Coat desired wells/plates with the diluted Matrigel.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 to 60 minutes.
Ensure original plates have PBS or media to prevent the matrix from drying out if Matrigel is being re-used to coat additional plates.
Use coated plates within 14 days.

steps.title: Maintain and Feed iPSCs
steps.instruction: Provide regular nutrient replenishment to the cultured cells.

substeps.instruction: Feed PSCs the day after seeding, then every other day thereafter.
If cells are left without feeding for two days (e.g., over a weekend), double the feed volume (e.g., 4 mL per well of a 6-well plate).

steps.title: Dissociate iPSCs for Splitting
steps.instruction: Prepare and detach iPSCs when they reach approximately 80% confluency.

substeps.instruction: Tilt the cell-containing plate towards the user and aspirate existing media.
Wash wells once with ample PBS (approximately 2x the volume of the media).
Add Accutase to the well(s) and incubate at 37°C for 3 minutes; add another 1 to 2 minutes if cells have not mostly lifted/dissociated.
Add ample PBS to the accutase-containing well(s) to dilute the Accutase.

steps.title: Collect and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Mechanically release and concentrate the dissociated cells.

substeps.instruction: Pipette up and down gently to mechanically release remaining cells, collect them, and add to appropriately-sized conical tubes.
Centrifuge cells at 200 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in medium containing Rock inhibitor for counting and dilution.

substeps.instruction: Add an appropriate volume of StemFlex + 10 μM Rock inhibitor to the conicals based on pellet size.
Note: For first-time use, aliquot Rock inhibitor at 10mM [1000x] in DPBS and dilute to 10 μM for use on cells.
Triturate to resuspend cells, minimizing pipette contact with the conical wall.
Remove 10 μL of the suspension and add it to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Seed iPSCs
steps.instruction: Calculate the required cell number and plate the cells.

substeps.instruction: Count cells and calculate the desired number of cells to seed.
Dilute the volume with additional StemFlex + Rock inhibitor to plate.
For general passaging, adding resuspended cells at 1:100, 1:50, and 1:20 of the final well volume typically provides near-confluency in 7, 5, and 3 days, respectively.

steps.title: Cryopreserve iPSCs
steps.instruction: Freeze iPSCs using a freezing medium consisting of StemFlex + 10% DMSO.
